mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_clue_owner_history (clue_id, from_owner_id, to_owner_id, assigned_by, reason, assigned_time) VALUES (#{clueId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{fromOwnerId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{toOwnerId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{assignedBy,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{assignedTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select: SELECT h.id, h.clue_id, h.from_owner_id, h.to_owner_id, h.assigned_by, h.reason, h.assigned_time, from_user.name AS from_owner_name, to_user.name AS to_owner_name, assigned_user.name AS assigned_by_name FROM t_clue_owner_history h LEFT JOIN t_user from_user ON h.from_owner_id = from_user.id LEFT JOIN t_user to_user ON h.to_owner_id = to_user.id LEFT JOIN t_user assigned_user ON h.assigned_by = assigned_user.id WHERE h.clue_id = #{clueId,jdbcType=INTEGER} ORDER BY h.assigned_time DESC, h.id DESC
